response.text: The dictionary says APINVH has "V void" status, but no void rows appear. The dictionary also has no entries for the GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO or GLJRNL/APINVH relationships. Let me check the sign conventions, the dates, and whether the journal balances and invoice/payment reconciles.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'jrnl_balance' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM("DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM("CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(CASE WHEN "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN "DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_sides FROM "GLJRNL";

SELECT 'orphan_jrnl_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_acct', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_inv_vend', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APVEND" v ON v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD" WHERE v."VEND_CD" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_pay_inv', COUNT(*) FROM "APPAYM" p LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_inv_jrnl', COUNT(*) FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnh_bad_period', COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h LEFT JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE p."PRD_ID" IS NULL;

SELECT i."STAT_CD", COUNT(*) AS invs, SUM(i."INV_AMT") AS inv_amt, COUNT(p."PAY_ID") AS pays, SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN p."PAY_AMT" IS NOT NULL AND ABS(p."PAY_AMT") > i."INV_AMT" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overpaid_rows, MIN(i."INV_DT") AS min_dt, MAX(i."INV_DT") AS max_dt FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."STAT_CD";
